types.label: Auto-lander paused
types.description: The auto-lander was paused (from the Auto-lander tab, the CLI, MCP or voice): nothing new lands until it is resumed. Resolved when it resumes.

types.label: PR held by the gate
types.description: A PR waiting to land fails a gate rule and needs a fix (red CI, a failing check, a code clash, UI Review changes). Once per PR and rule; resolved when it passes or leaves the line.

types.label: Auto-lander gave up on a build
types.description: The server auto-lander tried to fix and land a build maxAttempts times and stopped: what broke, since when and the last attempt's log, with a Fix (reset and start a fix session). Retired with the auto-lander@1 runner (Nov 19 2026): the lander (deploy/lander/run.mjs) never gives up and never escalates, so this is no longer sent; repeated failures show on the systems check instead.
